title: Aimee Soto
text: Aimee Soto is a master’s student of Civic Analytics at the University of Illinois Chicago. She currently works with the Government Finance Research Center on two research projects pertaining to Illinois cannabis and expenditure forecasting. Aimee enjoys spending time with her loved ones and exploring new parts of Chicago.

title: Past Project Showcase
text: The assignment here was to review a case study from the Harvard Kennedy School. The case demonstrated Jamaica’s PATH program and asked students to review the goals of the program and identify the best design for the program’s assessment. The policy memo is meant to mimic a memo that would be sent to the Minister of Labor and Social Security offering a recommendation for their PATH program. The assignment demonstrates the skills of policy assessment and evaluation. Policy is only as good as those that develop and know how to properly evaluate it, this assignment helps builds my policy development and processing skills.
